claims.statement: Crovia records what training-data information was observable on specified public surfaces during a defined observation window.
limitations: A missing public disclosure does not establish intent, illegality, or the absence of private evidence.

claims.statement: Crovia Seal is an experimental tamper-evident receipt format developed alongside draft-crovia-seal-01.
limitations: An Internet-Draft is not an IETF standard or endorsement.

claims.statement: Signature, Merkle inclusion, OpenTimestamps submission, and Bitcoin confirmation are separate verification states.
limitations: A signature proves integrity and control of a signing key; it does not by itself prove the truth or legality of a claim.
